desc: Implement a helper function for modular exponentiation to compute (m-1)^(n-1-k) % MOD efficiently.
Implement a helper function to compute the binomial coefficient C(n-1, k) % MOD using precomputed factorials or direct computation with modular inverse.
Compute the final answer as (C(n-1, k) * m * pow(m-1, n-1-k, MOD)) % MOD.
Handle edge cases: if m == 1 and k != n-1, return 0; if m == 1 and k == n-1, return 1; if n == 1, return m % MOD.
Write the main function `countGoodArrays` that ties these components together and returns the result.
